input_text: During the ceremony under the full moon, pack leader Ryker declares in public that he rejects his destined mate Selene, saying she is feeble since she cannot transform. Exiled from her pack, Selene stumbles into the hills. A fading elder wolf tells her she descends from the Moon Goddess and her strength is stirring. When feral wolves raid Ryker's territory, he is helpless. Selene comes back, becomes a white wolf and routs them. Ryker pleads with her to take him back and she resolves to refuse.
